name: Agent Gov Graph Ontology
description: Semantic definitions for runtime agent governance, investigation, and evidence relationships.

Actor.description: An entity that performs actions in an agent workflow, such as an AI agent or human.

Run.description: A single execution of an agent workflow.

Step.description: An observed action or event within a run.

Resource.description: A data object or protected resource accessed during a step.

Tool.description: A tool, service, or capability invoked during a step.

Decision.description: A runtime governance decision produced for a governed action.

ApprovalRequest.description: A proposed agent action or payload presented for approval before execution.

Approval.description: A human or system approval decision bound to a proposed action.

Policy.description: A versioned executable governance policy applied to a decision.

Finding.description: A governance-relevant condition identified from observed behavior.

Investigation.description: A selected inquiry into a governance finding.

Hypothesis.description: A testable possible explanation for an observed finding.

Experiment.description: A controlled intervention designed to test a hypothesis.

Evidence.description: Observed experimental or runtime evidence relevant to a hypothesis.

CONTAINS_STEP.description: Connects a workflow run to a step observed within that run.

PERFORMED.description: Indicates which actor performed a step.

PRECEDES.description: Represents an observed parent or predecessor relationship between steps.

ACCESSED.description: Indicates that a step attempted to access or use a resource.

CALLED.description: Indicates that a step invoked a tool.

DELEGATED_TO.description: Indicates an observed delegation relationship between actors.

REQUESTED_APPROVAL.description: Indicates that an actor submitted a proposed action for approval.

ISSUED_APPROVAL.description: Indicates that an actor issued an approval decision.

APPROVED_REQUEST.description: Links an approval decision to the exact proposed action or payload that was approved.

EXECUTED_FROM.description: Links an executed runtime step to the proposed action or payload from which it originated.

PRODUCED_DECISION.description: Links a governed runtime step to its governance decision evidence.

APPLIED_POLICY.description: Identifies the versioned policy applied to produce a governance decision.

PRODUCED_FINDING.description: Links observed runtime behavior to a governance finding.

INVESTIGATED_BY.description: Indicates that a finding was selected for investigation.

HAS_HYPOTHESIS.description: Connects an investigation to a candidate explanation being tested.

TESTED_BY.description: Connects a hypothesis to a controlled experiment designed to test it.

PRODUCED_EVIDENCE.description: Indicates that an experiment produced evidence.

SUPPORTS.description: Indicates that evidence supports, but does not by itself prove, a hypothesis.

CONTRADICTS.description: Indicates that evidence contradicts a hypothesis.
